name: Copycat Shade
notes: DRAFT for C13-3 (bestiary-plan.md). Copies your last move a moment later. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (R-BAL-8). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second). Appears only from floor 3 of its tier (Manager's call, C13-4).
tell: your move's shape in red, then it copies
senseiLine: It copies you. Surprise it kindly.
description: Copies your last move a moment later.

bestiary.tip: Try a different move, then COUNTER its copy.

lore.red-black: A shadow that only knew how to copy. Free it, and it finds its own way to move.
